method: Complete substantive official Applied Mathematics doctoral recruitment strategy page read through web tool; Chinese field names retained with English translations, no external interpretation presented as source title.

sources.evidence: Actual Department of Applied Mathematics doctoral recruitment page lists five main research groups: 數學建模與科學計算 (Mathematical Modeling and Scientific Computing), 財務工程與機率 (Financial Engineering and Probability), 微分方程與動態系統 (Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems), 離散數學與最優化 (Discrete Mathematics and Optimization), 數論、幾何與分析 (Number Theory, Geometry and Analysis). Text says professional courses designed for each area. None names Operations Research, Management Science or Industrial Engineering.

recommendation: Applied Mathematics doctoral field inventory now directly checked. Discrete Mathematics and Optimization is not relabelled Operations Research; no additional eligible route. Preserve existing three programme IDs and original dates. Other current branch inventory gaps remain separate; no whole-institution completion claim.
limitations: Five labels are explicitly research groups on doctoral recruitment page, not invented distinct degree awards or separate departments.
Page last-updated stamp 16 December 2024 retained as source publication context; accessed 25 October 2026. No exact doctoral credential conversion or historical NCTU diploma substitution.
